description: Java source code for the PubSupervisor class, which manages actor supervision for publication-related actors in an Akka-based system.

classes.name: PubSupervisor
classes.description: Actor class that supervises publication-related actors, managing their lifecycle and message handling.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for the PubSupervisor actor with given distributed data.

methods.name: createPubSubBehavior
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior for publication messages.

methods.name: onChildFailure
methods.description: Handles failure of child actors by resetting the publisher reference.

methods.name: startChildren
methods.description: Initializes child actors for PubUpdater and Publisher.

methods.name: isPublisherAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the publisher actor is available.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Sends a publish message to the publisher actor.

methods.name: publisherUnavailable
methods.description: Logs an error when the publisher actor is unavailable.
